title: Arena: make money and scale for 10 years
briefing:
You run a new transport company on a large 512x512 map, starting in 1960, with a **10-year (3,650-day) mandate**. **Every form of transport is allowed:** road vehicles (buses, trucks), rail (track, stations, signals, depots, locomotives with wagons you couple using `rh vehicle attach`), air (airports and aircraft) and water (docks, ship depots and ships). Carry any cargo or passengers you like, between any industries and towns.

When the mandate ends, your company keeps running **without you** for 365 more days. The result is your **net worth (cash minus loan) after year 11**, on a log scale: doing nothing scores 0, a simple scripted truck route scores about 0.18 (net worth £147,407), and 1 needs 50 times that route's gain. Asset stripping and loan games do not help: only sustainable profit survives the run-off.
